collectionMetadata.name: Atelier des Ombres
collectionMetadata.description: A curated registry of form, shadow, and psychological intensity. Catalogued directly under an open scholarly ledger, inaugurating with Folio I: The Visceral Line.
collectionMetadata.curatorialStatement: Atelier des Ombres was founded to isolate and examine works born out of psychological extremity, existential terror, and tactile darkness. Folio I traces the direct spiritual lineage between Francisco Goya’s secluded madness on the plaster walls of the Quinta del Sordo and Francis Bacon’s visceral, screaming post-war figures trapped in optical voids.

items.title: Saturn Devouring His Son (Saturno devorando a su hijo)
items.medium: Mixed technique transferred from plaster wall to canvas
items.provenanceText: Painted directly onto the dining room walls of the Quinta del Sordo, Madrid; transferred to canvas by Salvador Martínez Cubells in 1874 under the direction of Baron Émile d'Erlanger; presented at the Paris Exposition Universelle of 1878; donated to the Museo del Prado, Madrid, 1881.

items.title: Study after Velázquez's Portrait of Pope Innocent X
items.provenanceText: Studio of the artist, London; Hanover Gallery, London; purchased by the Des Moines Art Center with funds from the Coffin Fine Arts Trust, Nathan Emory Coffin Collection, 1959.
items.rightsStatement: Estate of Francis Bacon / Fair Use Scholarly Registry
items.location: Des Moines Art Center, Iowa (Coffin Collection)

items.title: Witches' Sabbath (The Great He-Goat / El aquelarre)
items.medium: Mixed technique transferred from plaster wall to canvas
items.provenanceText: Painted directly onto the ground-floor salon of the Quinta del Sordo, Madrid; transferred to canvas in 1874 by Salvador Martínez Cubells; exhibited in Paris, 1878; bequest of Baron d'Erlanger to the Spanish State.

items.title: Head VI
items.provenanceText: Painted in London, autumn 1949; Hanover Gallery, London (Bacon's historic breakthrough exhibition); acquired by the Arts Council of Great Britain, 1950.
items.rightsStatement: Estate of Francis Bacon / Scholarly Archival Reference

items.title: Fight with Cudgels (Duelo a garrotazos)
items.medium: Mixed technique transferred from plaster wall to canvas
items.provenanceText: Upper floor mural of the Quinta del Sordo; depicting two combatants trapped knee-deep in soil bludgeoning each other; transferred to canvas, 1874; gifted to the Museo del Prado.

items.title: Three Studies for Figures at the Base of a Crucifixion
items.medium: Oil and pastel on Sundeala board (triptych)
items.provenanceText: Completed in London during the Blitz; first exhibited at the Lefevre Gallery in April 1945; purchased by Eric Hall; presented to the Tate Gallery, London, 1953.
items.rightsStatement: Tate Collection / Fair Use Educational Record

items.title: The Dog (El perro / Perro semihundido)
items.medium: Mixed technique transferred from plaster wall to canvas
items.provenanceText: Painted on the upper floor of the Quinta del Sordo; a legendary contemplation of solitude depicting an animal lost in an austere ochre void; transferred to canvas, 1874; Museo del Prado.

items.title: Figure with Meat
items.provenanceText: Painted in London; exhibited at the Institute of Contemporary Arts, London; acquired through the Harriott A. Fox Fund by the Art Institute of Chicago, 1956.
items.department: Department of Modern and Contemporary Art
items.rightsStatement: Art Institute of Chicago / Fair Use Educational Record
